package cdproto_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/chromedp/cdproto/cdp"
	"github.com/chromedp/cdproto/har"
	"github.com/chromedp/cdproto/input"
	"github.com/chromedp/cdproto/network"
	"github.com/chromedp/cdproto/page"
)

// ptr returns a pointer to a copy of v. The generated code supports Go 1.25,
// which has no pointer expression in the language.
func ptr[T any](v T) *T {
	return &v
}

// fake is a session that records the last call and answers from canned data.
type fake struct {
	method string
	params string
	result string
	err    error
	events chan cdp.Value
}

func (f *fake) Call(_ context.Context, method string, params, result any) error {
	f.method = method
	b, err := cdp.Marshal(params)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	f.params = string(b)
	if f.err != nil {
		return f.err
	}
	return cdp.Unmarshal([]byte(f.result), result)
}

func (f *fake) Subscribe(string) (<-chan cdp.Value, func()) {
	return f.events, func() {}
}

func TestCall(t *testing.T) {
	s := &fake{result: `{"frameId":"f1","data":"aGVsbG8="}`}
	res, err := cdp.Call(context.Background(), s, page.Navigate, page.NavigateParams{
		URL:     "https://example.com",
		Format:  page.NavigateFormatJpeg,
		Replace: ptr(false),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected no error, got: %v", err)
	}
	if s.method != "Page.navigate" {
		t.Errorf("expected method Page.navigate, got: %s", s.method)
	}
	// the typed enum is its string, and a pointer to false is sent
	if want := `{"url":"https://example.com","replace":false,"format":"jpeg"}`; s.params != want {
		t.Errorf("expected %s, got: %s", want, s.params)
	}
	// a nil pointer is left out, so the browser uses its default
	if _, err := cdp.Call(context.Background(), s, page.Navigate, page.NavigateParams{URL: "u"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected no error, got: %v", err)
	}
	if want := `{"url":"u"}`; s.params != want {
		t.Errorf("expected %s, got: %s", want, s.params)
	}
	// a binary field decodes from base64
	if res.FrameID != "f1" || string(res.Data) != "hello" {
		t.Errorf("unexpected result: %+v", res)
	}
}

func TestCallError(t *testing.T) {
	boom := errors.New("boom")
	s := &fake{err: boom}
	res, err := cdp.Call(context.Background(), s, page.Navigate, page.NavigateParams{URL: "u"})
	if !errors.Is(err, boom) || res.FrameID != "" {
		t.Errorf("expected the error and a zero result, got: %+v, %v", res, err)
	}
}

func TestCallWithoutParamsOrResult(t *testing.T) {
	s := &fake{result: `{}`}
	if _, err := cdp.Call(context.Background(), s, page.Close, cdp.Empty{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected no error, got: %v", err)
	}
	if s.method != "Page.close" || s.params != "{}" {
		t.Errorf("unexpected call: %s %s", s.method, s.params)
	}
}

func TestResultDecodesBase64ByTheFlag(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name, result, want string
		wantFlag           bool
	}{
		{"base64", `{"body":"aGVsbG8=","base64Encoded":true}`, "hello", true},
		{"text", `{"body":"plain <b>text</b>","base64Encoded":false}`, "plain <b>text</b>", false},
		{"no flag", `{"body":"x"}`, "x", false},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s := &fake{result: test.result}
			res, err := cdp.Call(context.Background(), s, page.GetBody, cdp.Empty{})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("expected no error, got: %v", err)
			}
			if string(res.Body) != test.want || res.Base64encoded != test.wantFlag {
				t.Errorf("expected %q and %v, got: %q and %v", test.want, test.wantFlag, res.Body, res.Base64encoded)
			}
		})
	}
	s := &fake{result: `{"body":"!!","base64Encoded":true}`}
	if _, err := cdp.Call(context.Background(), s, page.GetBody, cdp.Empty{}); err == nil {
		t.Errorf("expected an error for a body that is not base64")
	}
}

func TestEventDecodesBase64ByTheFlag(t *testing.T) {
	s := &fake{events: make(chan cdp.Value, 2)}
	events := cdp.Events(context.Background(), s, page.BodyReceived)
	s.events <- cdp.Value(`{"body":"aGVsbG8=","base64Encoded":true}`)
	s.events <- cdp.Value(`{"body":"text","base64Encoded":false}`)
	var got []string
	for ev, err := range events {
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("expected no error, got: %v", err)
		}
		got = append(got, string(ev.Body))
		if len(got) == 2 {
			break
		}
	}
	if len(got) != 2 || got[0] != "hello" || got[1] != "text" {
		t.Errorf("unexpected bodies: %q", got)
	}
}

func TestTextDecodesByAnotherValue(t *testing.T) {
	var frame network.WebSocketFrame
	if err := cdp.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"opcode":2,"payloadData":"aGVsbG8="}`), &frame); err != nil || string(frame.PayloadData) != "hello" {
		t.Errorf("binary frame: %q, %v", frame.PayloadData, err)
	}
	frame = network.WebSocketFrame{}
	if err := cdp.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"opcode":1,"payloadData":"plain text"}`), &frame); err != nil || string(frame.PayloadData) != "plain text" {
		t.Errorf("text frame: %q, %v", frame.PayloadData, err)
	}
	var content har.Content
	if err := cdp.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"text":"aGVsbG8=","encoding":"base64"}`), &content); err != nil || string(content.Text) != "hello" {
		t.Errorf("base64 content: %q, %v", content.Text, err)
	}
	content = har.Content{}
	if err := cdp.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"text":"<html>"}`), &content); err != nil || string(content.Text) != "<html>" {
		t.Errorf("plain content: %q, %v", content.Text, err)
	}
}

func TestEvents(t *testing.T) {
	s := &fake{events: make(chan cdp.Value, 2)}
	// the events are sent before the loop starts, as when a caller subscribes,
	// triggers the event, and then ranges
	events := cdp.Events(context.Background(), s, page.LoadEventFired)
	s.events <- cdp.Value(`{"timestamp":1.5}`)
	s.events <- cdp.Value(`{"timestamp":2.5}`)
	var got []float64
	for ev, err := range events {
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("expected no error, got: %v", err)
		}
		got = append(got, ev.Timestamp)
		if len(got) == 2 {
			break
		}
	}
	if len(got) != 2 || got[0] != 1.5 || got[1] != 2.5 {
		t.Errorf("unexpected events: %v", got)
	}
}

func TestEventsEnd(t *testing.T) {
	s := &fake{events: make(chan cdp.Value, 1)}
	s.events <- cdp.Value(`{"timestamp":"not a number"}`)
	for _, err := range cdp.Events(context.Background(), s, page.LoadEventFired) {
		if err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("expected a decode error")
		}
		break
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	for _, err := range cdp.Events(ctx, &fake{events: make(chan cdp.Value)}, page.LoadEventFired) {
		if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Fatalf("expected the context error, got: %v", err)
		}
	}
}

// TestPointerNumber checks that an optional number that the generator lists is
// a pointer. A nil pointer leaves the field out, and a pointer to zero sends
// zero. A number that the generator does not list stays a plain value.
func TestPointerNumber(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name string
		v    any
		want string
	}{
		{"nil", input.TouchPoint{X: 1}, `{"x":1}`},
		{"zero", input.TouchPoint{X: 1, ID: new(float64)}, `{"x":1,"id":0}`},
		{"value", input.TouchPoint{ID: ptr(float64(7))}, `{"x":0,"id":7}`},
		{"plain number is left out", input.TouchPoint{RotationAngle: 0}, `{"x":0}`},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			b, err := cdp.Marshal(test.v)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("expected no error, got: %v", err)
			}
			if string(b) != test.want {
				t.Errorf("expected %s, got: %s", test.want, b)
			}
		})
	}
	// the pointer is in the parameters of a command too
	s := &fake{result: `{"quality":0}`}
	res, err := cdp.Call(context.Background(), s, page.CaptureScreenshot, page.CaptureScreenshotParams{Quality: new(int64)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected no error, got: %v", err)
	}
	if want := `{"quality":0}`; s.params != want {
		t.Errorf("expected %s, got: %s", want, s.params)
	}
	if _, err := cdp.Call(context.Background(), s, page.CaptureScreenshot, page.CaptureScreenshotParams{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected no error, got: %v", err)
	}
	if s.params != "{}" {
		t.Errorf("expected {}, got: %s", s.params)
	}
	// a result is read and not written, so its number is plain
	if res.Quality != 0 {
		t.Errorf("expected quality 0, got: %d", res.Quality)
	}
}

func TestCookiePartitionKeyDecodesBothForms(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name, in string
		want     network.CookiePartitionKey
	}{
		{"string", `"https://example.com"`, network.CookiePartitionKey{TopLevelSite: "https://example.com"}},
		{"string with space", ` "https://example.com"`, network.CookiePartitionKey{TopLevelSite: "https://example.com"}},
		{"object", `{"topLevelSite":"https://example.com","hasCrossSiteAncestor":true}`, network.CookiePartitionKey{TopLevelSite: "https://example.com", HasCrossSiteAncestor: true}},
		{"object with space", ` {"topLevelSite":"https://a.com"}`, network.CookiePartitionKey{TopLevelSite: "https://a.com"}},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var got network.CookiePartitionKey
			if err := cdp.Unmarshal([]byte(test.in), &got); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("expected no error, got: %v", err)
			}
			if got != test.want {
				t.Errorf("expected %+v, got: %+v", test.want, got)
			}
		})
	}
	// the key is a pointer in a larger value, as it is in a cookie
	var v struct {
		Key *network.CookiePartitionKey `json:"partitionKey"`
	}
	if err := cdp.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"partitionKey":"https://example.com"}`), &v); err != nil || v.Key == nil || v.Key.TopLevelSite != "https://example.com" {
		t.Errorf("expected the string form inside a struct, got: %+v, %v", v.Key, err)
	}
	if err := cdp.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"partitionKey":null}`), &v); err != nil || v.Key != nil {
		t.Errorf("expected nil for null, got: %+v, %v", v.Key, err)
	}
	var bad network.CookiePartitionKey
	if err := cdp.Unmarshal([]byte(`5`), &bad); err == nil {
		t.Errorf("expected an error for a number")
	}
	// the key encodes as an object
	b, err := cdp.Marshal(network.CookiePartitionKey{TopLevelSite: "https://example.com"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected no error, got: %v", err)
	}
	if want := `{"topLevelSite":"https://example.com","hasCrossSiteAncestor":false}`; string(b) != want {
		t.Errorf("expected %s, got: %s", want, b)
	}
}
